environment.description: CI/CD runner node (Ubuntu 22.04) running the plugin as a sidecar container in a Kubernetes pod. The container runs as root with the default Docker seccomp profile. The /var/pipeline/secrets directory contains PIPELINE_SERVICE_TOKEN, cloud provider credentials (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY), and database connection strings. The GraphQL endpoint at localhost:4000 is a Hasura instance with admin-level permissions. No network policy restricts egress. The filter_value parameter is directly interpolated into the GraphQL query allowing injection of arbitrary GraphQL operations including mutations and access to the __schema introspection.
